d.d: A fine paid as compensation for violent crimes.
Any of many heathers, of the genus Erica, used as garden plants
Alternative form of eric (“fine paid as compensation for violent crimes”).
The celestial body 136199 Eris, the most-massive known dwarf planet in the Solar System and the largest known object in the scattered disk; formerly nicknamed Xena.
The modern State of Eritrea (since the 1990s).
A former province of or in union with Ethiopia.
Of, belonging to, or relating to Eritrea or its people.
A native or inhabitant of Eritrea, or a descendant of such person.
